description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to latest LTS versions

tasks.description: Upgrade to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.4
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to 21, Spring Boot to 3.4, Spring Framework to 6.x, and migrate javax.* to jakarta.* namespace if needed. Update all related Spring dependencies (Spring Security, Spring Data, etc.) to versions compatible with Spring Boot 3.4. Ensure build tooling (Maven/Gradle) plugins are updated to support Java 21.
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded Java from 8 to 21 and Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 3.4.5. Migrated javax.* to jakarta.* namespace, updated Spring Framework to 6.2.x, fixed CVEs by upgrading commons-io to 2.18.0. Build passed, unit tests passed (1/1), no security vulnerabilities detected.
